_about: Per-work Blau overlay for al-Qirqisani's Kitāb al-Anwār (al-Anwar), Maqāla I. Rendered ONLY in /advanced/qirqisani-anwar. Source: Joshua Blau, A Dictionary of Medieval Judaeo-Arabic Texts (Jerusalem 2006); these lemmas are tagged in Blau as attested in al-Qirqisani (קרקסאני) — the work Blau cites most heavily — and are extracted by ~/Tools/arabic-lexicon/blau-by-work/extract_blau_by_work.py. Each note surfaces the special Judaeo-Arabic sense(s) Blau records, beyond the neutral classical gloss the shared dictionary already shows.

notes.blau_sense_en: Beyond 'first' (al-awwal), Blau attests for Qirqisani the verb ʾawwala: 'to interpret', and pointedly 'to explain away, to use as a pretext, to equivocate, to speak with ambiguity' — the very charge at the heart of Qirqisani's polemic over (mis)reading Scripture.
notes.blau_sense_he: לְפָרֵשׁ; לְסַלֵּף, לְהִשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ כַּאֲמַתְלָה, לְדַבֵּר בִּדְבָרִים דּוּ-מַשְׁמָעִיִּים
notes.attested_in: Blau, Dict. of Medieval Judaeo-Arabic (attested in Qirqisani)

notes.blau_sense_en: Beyond 'door / chapter', Blau records the Judaeo-Arabic senses 'a matter, subject, topic', 'accepted usage, customary linguistic practice', and (grammatical) 'category, type'.
notes.blau_sense_he: עִנְיָן, נוֹשֵׂא; שִׁמּוּשׁ לְשׁוֹנִי מְקֻבָּל; (דקדוק) סוּג, קָטֵגוֹרְיָה
notes.attested_in: Blau, Dict. of Medieval Judaeo-Arabic (attested in Qirqisani)

notes.blau_sense_en: Besides 'argument, proof', Blau records for Qirqisani the polemical sense 'pretext, subterfuge', as well as 'authority' and (concretely) 'title-deed, promissory note'.
notes.blau_sense_he: מִלְּבַד 'טַעֲנָה, רְאָיָה': גַּם אֲמַתְלָה, תֵּרוּץ; סַמְכוּת; שְׁטָר
notes.attested_in: Blau, Dict. of Medieval Judaeo-Arabic (attested in Qirqisani)

notes.blau_sense_en: A very wide Judaeo-Arabic range in Blau, several senses central to Qirqisani's epistemology: 'to adduce proof for', 'to adduce proof from, to infer from', 'to demonstrate, to prove', 'it emerged / was shown that' — but also 'to pretend, to profess, to make an excuse'.
notes.blau_sense_he: לְהָבִיא רְאָיָה; לְהַסִּיק מִן; לְהוֹכִיחַ; הִתְבָּרֵר שֶׁ — וְגַם: לְהֵעָמֵד פָּנִים, לְהִתְנַצֵּל
notes.attested_in: Blau, Dict. of Medieval Judaeo-Arabic (attested in Qirqisani)

notes.blau_sense_en: Beyond 'good / better', Blau attests for Qirqisani 'to claim superiority, to be superior', 'to want', 'to choose', and notably 'to decide by divination, to leave the choice to God'.
notes.blau_sense_he: לְהִתְיַמֵּר בְּעֶלְיוֹנוּת; לִרְצוֹת; לִבְחֹר; לְהַטִּיל גּוֹרָל, לְהַנִּיחַ הַבְּחִירָה לָאֵל
notes.attested_in: Blau, Dict. of Medieval Judaeo-Arabic (attested in Qirqisani)
